# metric-autopsy

> A metric-agnostic gate system that red-teams a computed single-cell RNA-seq metric to
> separate biological signal from QC, technical, and mathematical artifacts. Ships as a
> Claude Code skill, a pip package, and an MCP server. The design principle: invert the
> default from "compute → believe" to "state your commitments → red-team → then believe."

You pass a black-box `metric(data) -> float`, your factorial `obs` column names, the
biological replicate column and a pre-registration (estimand, SESOI). Eight gates probe the
data and the metric's response to controlled perturbations; one rule (`report.decide`) turns
four fields — metric validity, design adequacy, effect (replicate-level, at equal depth or
spike-in capture), replication — into the verdict. GATE 4 (alternative explanations) and
GATE 7 (effect size) are judgment a human/agent resolves. Status: v0.3.0-prereg passed the
pre-registered blind validation v1, within its scope only (README, Status); do not call a verdict
validated outside that scope, and inside it cite the error rates from scores.json.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): pitch, quickstart, the reference `--demo` failure, install.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should drive the tool (three entry points, the one rule).
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the Claude Code skill protocol (elicit pre-reg → run gates → autopsy).

## The gates (reference)
- [references/gates.md](references/gates.md): full definition and rationale of every gate; the methods source.
- [references/red_flags.md](references/red_flags.md): the 12-row red-flag table, each with a real example.
- [references/prereg_template.md](references/prereg_template.md): the pre-registration / elicitation form.

## Use it through an agent
- [src/metric_autopsy/mcp_server.py](src/metric_autopsy/mcp_server.py): MCP tools — `autopsy_report`, `qc_parity_report`, `list_metrics`, `demo_report`. Install `metric-autopsy[mcp]`, run `metric-autopsy-mcp`.

## Code (source of truth)
- [src/metric_autopsy/gates.py](src/metric_autopsy/gates.py): the gates as functions.
- [src/metric_autopsy/qc.py](src/metric_autopsy/qc.py): factorial QC parity (+ legacy n_genes matching).
- [src/metric_autopsy/effect.py](src/metric_autopsy/effect.py): estimand-dependent correction, replicate-level effect, graded rule, power.
- [src/metric_autopsy/equalize.py](src/metric_autopsy/equalize.py): thinning to equal depth / spike-in capture.
- [src/metric_autopsy/stats.py](src/metric_autopsy/stats.py): t and permutation tests, TOST, MDE.
- [src/metric_autopsy/injected_signal.py](src/metric_autopsy/injected_signal.py): injected construct changes for GATE 4.
- [src/metric_autopsy/provenance.py](src/metric_autopsy/provenance.py): hashes, versions, run log.
- [src/metric_autopsy/metrics.py](src/metric_autopsy/metrics.py): reference metrics.
- [src/metric_autopsy/report.py](src/metric_autopsy/report.py): run_autopsy orchestration, the four fields, `decide`.
